findings.title: [P2] Enforce the v2 blocking Size limit requirement on restored plans
findings.body: A v2 Size policy with all numeric limits null and matchingFiles empty is valid for advisory use. If a restored plan uses that policy on a blocking node, resolvedTestPlanErrors accepts it because the no-limit check exists only in the resolver. The retained runner/loader checks also accept it. ProviderInvocationV1 carries no mode, so the Size provider's invocation.mode === 'blocking' guard never fires during normal execution; it measures the artifact and returns passed with no budget checks. Apply the same blocking-limit invariant during resolved-plan validation so restored and remote plans cannot bypass resolver admission.

overall_explanation: The selected-policy transport and mandatory evidence checks are consistent, but restored blocking Size plans can bypass the new active-limit requirement and pass without evaluating a budget. Review was source-only; no tests or commands were executed.
